drafts.angle: Numbered 'biggest opportunities' list (rides @gregisenberg 'The biggest opportunities right now', 578K views, 18.2K bookmarks, about 1.9x likes)
drafts.draft_en:
The biggest opportunities in AI ads right now:

1. Checking creative, not making more of it. Generation is free. Review isn't.
2. A record of what was approved, by whom, against which rule
3. Claims checks before legal ever sees the ad
4. Platform-policy checks before Meta or TikTok rejects it
5. Brand rules written as tests, not PDFs

The more AI floods the feed, the more trust is worth.
drafts.video_tip: 30s talking head with a numbered on-screen list that builds one line per beat. Open on 'The biggest opportunities in AI ads right now' as a caption in the first second. End on the last line held for 2s. No music.

drafts.angle: Two-line aphorism, no link (rides @AlexHormozi 'Anything that looks easy only looks easy because you haven't done it yet', 101K, 5.6K likes, and @rauchg 'Work backwards from science fiction', 169K)
drafts.draft_en:
Ad review only looks easy until you're doing 500 a day.

No one is more confident than the team that's never had an ad pulled.
drafts.video_tip: 8–10s single-take selfie, one sentence per cut, white bold captions. No b-roll, no music. Post natively, no link in the post.

drafts.angle: 'The SOC 2 of X' analogy + governance (rides @rauchg 'ISO 42001:2023 is like the SOC2 of AI', 55K, 446 bookmarks, and @levie on agents solving problems you can't define yourself, 73K)
drafts.draft_en:
ISO 42001 is shaping up to be the SOC 2 of AI: an audit of how you build and govern AI systems.

It doesn't check the ads those systems make.

Every AI-generated image, video and script still needs a check against brand rules, legal claims and platform policy before it ships: approve, fix or block.

Governance has to reach the output.
drafts.video_tip: 25s screen recording: show a compliance badge, then an AI-made ad, then the ad running through an approve/fix/block check. Caption 'The SOC 2 of AI doesn't check your ads' as the hook in the first 2s.
